name: suede-clip-to-guide
description: Suede AI short-to-long content funnel: turns a video, clip, interview moment, talk excerpt, screen recording, or transcript into a scored, rights-checked package that bridges attention to an owned guide, X Article, LinkedIn article, newsletter, or playbook, and makes that guide the page search engines and AI answers find. Use when a clip must lead somewhere deeper, when third-party footage needs a rights route before reuse, or when an X post must pair native video with an owned Article card. NOT
author: JasonColapietro
